Hi Vivek —

Thanks for the quick demo last week. We got internal feedback from engineering and procurement and have three outstanding pricing/packaging questions before we can move to legal: 

1) Platform fee: how is it calculated for on-prem deployments? Are there minima or seat caps?
2) Support tiers: we need 24x7 oncall for our production cluster and a dedicated TAM — what's included and how do we price it?
3) Migration credits: do you offer any one-time credits for migration effort or professional services discounts tied to committed capacity?

We have a rough target: 3x A100-equivalent nodes initially, with a 12-month commitment. Our procurement lead (CC'd) asked for a simple commercial summary we can share with finance/legal.

Could you send a short proposal and SOW stub that breaks down platform fee vs license vs support?

Best,
Ellis Harper

ellis@archwell.health

Subject: Re: VPC licensing & platform fee questions

Ellis —

Thanks for the clear list. We can absolutely break this out. High-level answers first, then I'll attach a short proposal and SOW stub for procurement:

- Platform fee: fixed monthly platform fee that covers control plane services, update/patch orchestration, and access to the Redwood Console. For on-prem/VPC customers we offer either a flat platform fee (recommended for predictable cost) or a usage-adjusted variant. Minimum term is 12 months.
- Licensing: perpetual on-prem license + annual maintenance, or a subscription model. For your initial footprint (3x A100-eq) we typically price by peak capacity band.
- Support: Standard (business hours) vs Premium (24x7 + TAM). Premium includes a named TAM, quarterly architecture reviews, and a quarterly runbook refresh.
- Migration credits: we can offer one-time migration credits tied to committed capacity; size depends on the commitment level and whether you purchase pro services through Redwood or an approved partner.

I'll attach a clean one-page commercial summary and an SOW stub for your procurement team to review. If useful I can propose two commercial options (subscription vs perpetual + maintenance) and a recommended SOW with an estimated migration credit bucket.

Planning to loop in Marissa on the commercial comps and Steph on support scopes. Connor is on standby for legal redline questions.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai

From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai

Date: Tue, 13 Jan 2026 10:17:00 -08:00
Subject: Internal: Archwell commercial options (3x A100-eq)

Team —

Ellis asked for a simple procurement-ready summary. Proposed approach below. Please reply with redlines/concerns by EOD so I can send to Archwell tomorrow: 

Option A (Subscription, simplest for Archwell)
- Committed 12-month subscription for capacity band: 3 A100-eq nodes (peak)
- Platform fee: $12,000/month (flat) — includes Console, control plane, security updates
- Support: Premium ($8,000/month) — 24x7 oncall, named TAM, SLA 99.9
- Migration credit: $30,000 one-time applied to first invoice if they commit to 12-month subscription
- Notes: No perpetual license; on renewal, band resizes allowed with 30-day notice

Option B (Perpetual license + maintenance)
- Perpetual license for current model weights: $225,000 one-time
- Annual maintenance (incl platform updates delivered as packages): 18% ($40,500/year)
- Platform fee: $6,000/month (smaller, covers control plane hosting & telemetry)
- Support: Premium add-on $8,000/month or purchase blocks of oncall hours at $350/hr
- Migration credit: $20,000 if they sign SOW with Redwood-managed migration

Commercial asks / approvals:
- Approve migration credit buckets (A:30k vs B:20k)
- Confirm we can offer a fixed platform fee of $12k/month on subscription for a 12-month term without escalation clauses
- Legal: standard redlines on indemnity/data handling; Connor, can you confirm the SOW template is ok for Archwell's regulated healthcare use-case?

Marissa — taking the lead on the one-pager. Steph — review support addendum language (TAM responsibilities & escalation path).

Thanks,
Vivek
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai, connor_obrien@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 13 Jan 2026 15:48:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Internal: Archwell commercial options (3x A100-eq)

Agree with both options, minor edits:

- Recommend increasing migration credit in Option A to $35k to improve close velocity — Archwell is time-sensitive and we win by de-risking migration.
- Suggest platform fee floor clause: keep $12k/month fixed for 12 months, then CPI-linked increase capped at 3%/yr. Helps finance accept predictable step-up.
- For Option B, change maintenance from 18% to 16% if they sign a 2-year support commitment (good TCV incentive).

Connor — please pre-clear the SOW for HIPAA-adjacent language. If legal needs a special BAA template, flag now.

If all good I can produce the commercial one-pager + SOW stub attachments and Vivek can send to Ellis.

-Marissa
